newsitem.title: UK: Wickes to sells Wickes Continental.
newsitem.headline: Wickes to sells Wickes Continental.

text.p: British home improvement chain Wickes Plc said on Wednesday it had agreed to sell its Wickes Continental business to France's Bricorama S.A. for 7.5 million stg.

Wickes Continental, which last year reported a pretax loss of 12.3 million stg, operates 39 do-it-yourself stores in The Netherlands, Belgium and France. The group comprises Wickes B.V., Wickes N.V. and Wickes France SARL.
Wickes said Bricorama would pay cash on completion of the deal and also assume 6.4 million stg of finance leases on the balance sheet of Wickes Continental.
After expenses, the transaction is expected to cut Wickes debt by around 12.5 million stg, the company said.
